scope.summary: Implement the low-level utility pixel operators as StudioLiveFilter kinds: Custom Convolution (user 5x5 kernel, scale/offset, savable/loadable), Maximum/dilate (radius, squareness/roundness; spread masks), Minimum/erode (radius; choke masks), Offset (h/v shift with wrap/repeat-edge/background fill), De-Interlace (odd/even line removal by duplication/interpolation), Broadcast-Safe Colors (TV-safe gamut). Watermark is a RETIRED third-party surface, recorded as provenance-only and NOT shipped as a native Studio effect.
acceptance_criteria: Custom Convolution, Maximum(dilate), Minimum(erode), Offset, De-Interlace, Broadcast-Safe Colors

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-FX-022] Utility filters are low-level pixel operators used in masking, compositing, and legacy-format workflows. Maximum/Minimum are morphological dilate/erode used to choke/spread masks. The watermarking filter is a retired third-party surface, recorded for provenance only and NOT shipped as a native Studio effect. | Studio effect | Targets | GPU | Behavior (normative) | |---|---|---|---| | Custom Convolution | R | Opt | User-defined 5x5 convolution kernel with scale and offset; savable/loadable. | | Maximum (dilate) | R | Opt | Morphological dilate within a radius with squareness/roundness preservation (spread masks). | | Minimum (erode) | R | Opt | Morphological erode within a radius with squareness/roundness preservation (choke masks). | | Offset | R | Opt | Shifts the region horizontally/vertically with wrap-around, repeat-edge, or background fill of vacated areas. | | De-Interlace | R | No | Removes odd/even interlace lines by duplication or interpolation (video-source cleanup). | | Broadcast-Safe Colors | R | No | Restricts gamut to television-safe colors to prevent scan-line bleed. | | Watermark (retired) | R | No | Legacy third-party copyright-watermark embed; retired posture, NOT a native Studio effect. Provenance-only row. | --- ### 12. Interactive Filter Workspaces

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
